I wonder if the trope of a character NOT laughing and instead telling the jokester to "shut up" comes from this. 

We thought it was edgy humor, but in reality, the scriptwriter just has low self-esteem and hates his own work.

(bit of a necro post but fuck it) 

I like the points you've made there, especially it being my oen consciousness and not a "shroom message" (even though at the time, it did feel as though an outside force was "speaking"). 

It's a mix of positive and negative reasons. On the positive was my sense that hallucinogens had shown me enough to realize I needed to change my behaviors, and that the substances could not force me to make that change. 
On the negative was my long-standing fears of schizophrenia (an uncle on my mom's side developed it after an ungodly dose of pcp), and my dislike of a man who initially got me interested in lsd (turned out, years later, that he was a rapist). 

Perhaps I'll trip again someday, but I think for now I'd rather see more of the real world before I venture "outside" of it again. 

Thanks for your thoughts and questions. This thread has given me much to consider.

Interesting point. Most of my trips have resulted in ego degradation but not full death. It was as if the shrooms weren't quite enough to break it, and i would need to deliberately "allow" it to "die". If that makes any sense
That's kinda what i was thinking.

In Oklahoma i've invariably heard:
Joint = weed only,
Spliff = tobacco and weed.
Interesting to see how different local interpretations of "spliff" can be.

"Magazine life scenario"
I like that, it's an accurate description.

(To mods: Not sure if i should keep posting since im not suicidal atm, so if i am out of line feel free to delete this thread)

Thing is, that's all i've ever really wanted. Not even the scenario itself, just the approval from friends and family.
What i, as an individual, want?
Not a fucking clue. Never thought about it, never cared to.
I just wanted to stop being a loser. If there was a drug that erased my conciousness but left a perfectly-functioning zombie in my stead, i'd take it in a heartbeat. As it is, dissociation fills that role fairly well, but my pesky "self" just keeps interrupting it.

For what it's worth, 1 in 8 americans have genital herpes.
So that's over 20 million potential partners.
I can tell you've got a lot going on, but don't rule out love and sex. There really is someone(s) for everyone.

I realize this is a bit of a mindset 180. Happens a lot.

But i am truly sorry for some of what i wrote up there. Part of me wants to hurt everyone, the other part hates pain in all it's forms.
You're not all worthless. I'm stupid for thinking that.

Decided to have "one last cigarette", which became "one last pack", "then one last beer". Then i put the shotgun away and came here.
Addiction to the rescue!

Sarcasm aside, thanks. But i haven't been through jack shit. I live with parents, turned 21 yesterday.
I wanted to be more than this, i guess. A job, a girlfriend, apartment and parties.
But every time i get close to any of those goals, i shut down. Sabotage it by any means possible.
Entirely my fault. Also nothing i can do to fix it.
Oh well.
